messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PDR-4412 triggered \u2014 high GPU memory pressure on cluster gpu-pool-eu (node: gpu-eu-7). Symptoms: repeated CUDA OOMs in model-runtime pods, autoscaler not adding nodes. Severity: SEV2. ts=1880123456

jordan-oncall: ACKing PDR-4412. tagging @priya-sre and @leo-sre. I'm grabbing logs and checking which routes are affected.

priya-sre: seeing a spike on /api/v1/stream with long-context jobs. model-runtime v2.3.1 reports OOMs. Attaching sample log snippet below.
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1073741824 bytes (GPU 0; 16384.00 MiB total capacity; 15000.50 MiB already allocated; 24.50 MiB free)
  File "/srv/serve/handler.py", line 298, in process
    out = gen_model.generate(**inputs)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.9/site-packages/torch/cuda/__init__.py", line 250, in _lazy_init
    raise RuntimeError("CUDA out of memory")
```

leo-sre: ack. I'm pulling node metrics. Looks like one node hit 100% GPU mem and driver threw allocation failures. autoscaler didn't spin up because node group max=5 and we're at 5.

maya-platform: Suggest emergency mitigations: (1) enable auto-shedder for streaming route to drop large requests, (2) temporarily set max_context_length=1024 for prod streaming, (3) provision +2 nodes immediately and cordon the hotspot node.

jordan-oncall: Applying (1) and (2) now. Running config change:
```
redwoodctl routes patch streaming-prod --set auto_shed=true --set max_context_length=1024
```

deploy-bot: config change accepted, rollout started (id: r-20260314-gtk).

jordan-oncall: Also kicking off nodepool scale:
```
gcloud container clusters resize redwood-eu --node-pool gpu-pool-eu --num-nodes 7
```

priya-sre: While scaling, I'm going to cordon gpu-eu-7 and evict the most memory-hungry pods so kube can reschedule them.

leo-sre: cordon + drain executed: `kubectl cordon gpu-eu-7` then `kubectl drain gpu-eu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` 

priya-sre: After drain, nodes scheduled onto new nodes. I'm seeing fewer CUDA errors but still a handful. Running a quick canary: pin 20% traffic to int8-quantized model-server canary.

jordan-oncall: Routing change: free-tier and long-context labels -> cpu-fallback; canary traffic split 80/20 to quantized.

support-bot: Creating support cases for affected customers: S-12021 (CUST-221), S-12022 (CUST-778). Linking to PDR-4412.

maya-platform: Also dropped batch_size to 1 for streaming to minimize per-request memory. Command applied.

leo-sre: quick memory inspect: ran `torch.cuda.memory_summary()` inside a crashed container. Observed large persistent KV cache retention for streaming sessions; not freeing between requests for some sessions with many system messages. Filing bug: label investigate-kvcache.

priya-sre: dmesg on gpu-eu-7 showed repeated `gpu: failed to allocate` and driver stack traces. No kernel panic.
```
[  +0.000000] nvidia 0000:01:00.0: failed to allocate memory: -4
[  +0.000002] nvidia: CUDA: cuMemAlloc failed
```

jordan-oncall: Metrics after mitigations (10m window): 5xx rate streaming-prod 9.8% -> 1.1%, p95 latency 980ms -> 420ms. Impact window ~9 minutes.

leo-sre: Confirming new pods running on new nodes, no CUDA OOMs for 12m. Canary quantized shows acceptable quality on our quick eval set.

priya-sre: Assigning RCA: leo-sre -> root cause analysis (due 2026-03-19). maya-platform -> autoscaler config update (due 2026-03-16). support -> customer comms (tickets S-12021/S-12022).

nora-engr: ack. Please ensure RCA covers: request patterns, batching behavior, autoscaler max limits, driver logs, and quantized canary perf. Consider raising nodepool max to allow emergency headroom.

jordan-oncall: Handing primary to priya in ~7 minutes. Priya, you take over incident ownership for followups.

priya-sre: taking over. I'll keep the PD incident open until RCA link posted. Leaving thread with notes for postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty PDR-4412 acknowledged by jordan-oncall and marked RESOLVED at 1880123850. Follow-up tasks: leo-sre -> RCA (SLA due 2026-03-19), maya-platform -> autoscaler patch (2026-03-16), support -> customer comms (S-12021/S-12022).

jordan-oncall: TL;DR: immediate fixes = enable auto-shedder, reduce max_context_length, reduce batch_size, scale nodepool + cordon hot node, route free/long-context to cpu fallback, canary int8 quantized model. Impact: partial 5xxs for ~9m affecting a few customers. Next: RCA and autoscaler headroom. Good work team. :thumbsup:

priya-sre: I'll post the postmortem doc link here when ready and close the thread.
